{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask]

# Identify and exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
df_final = df_clean[~refunded_mask]

# Compute conversion rate: proportion of converted orders
conversion_rate = df_final['converted'].mean() * 100

# Output
print(f"Number of QA orders excluded: {qa_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders excluded: {refunded_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Final population size: {len(df_final)}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate:.2f}%")"}
